C2C Incident Receiver Resource Get C2cir Count
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudToCloudIR/count

Retrieves the number of DLP Incident Receivers configured for Cloud-to-Cloud Incident Forwarding

Request
​

string

The search string used to match against the names of Cloud-to-Cloud Incident Forwarding tenants and their configurations
